description.en: 通过扫码或机器人凭据把IM机器人接入DeepSeek Harness（支持飞书、微信、钉钉、企业微信、QQ、Slack、Telegram、Discord和WhatsApp）。 Connect IM bots to DeepSeek Harness via QR code or credentials (9 channels).
description.zh: 扫码或凭据接入IM机器人，让DeepSeek Harness在飞书、微信、钉钉等9个聊天平台随时可用。

description.en: Vendor parameter mapping and deterministic JSON repair for DeepSeek Harness: map temperature/top_p/max_tokens/stop/system across 11 vendors and repair broken JSON tool output with auditable rules.
description.zh: 把温度、top_p、max_tokens 等参数自动适配 11 家厂商，还能按规则修好工具返回的坏 JSON。

description.en: Free Markdown editor for Windows, VS Code & Trae, plus an IDE-style Markdown × AI workspace in DeepSeek Harness. Edit beside AI, send selected source to chat, resume notes per project, and write with live math, tables & diagrams.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里边写 Markdown 边用 AI 改稿，选中文字直接丢给对话，笔记按项目接着写。

description.en: Design with your coding agent — A skill, not a product: no MCP server, no app to install, no account, no build step, no npm install.
description.zh: 让编码助手直接帮你做网页设计，不用装服务、不用注册，纯技能即插即用。

description.en: 🗃️ 为 DSH 默认只加载基础工具，其余工具通过 activate_tools 按需加载。| Load only basic DSH tools by default, and activate the rest on demand via activate_tools.
description.zh: 默认只加载基础工具，其他工具按需激活，让 DSH 跑得更轻、更省资源。

description.en: dsh（DeepSeek Harness）的 QQ 群聊/私聊通道插件，基于 OneBot v11（NapCat）。 把 QQ 的世界映射进 Agent 上下文，把行动权交给 Agent 本身——插件不做任何代答。
description.zh: 把 QQ 群聊和私聊接入 DeepSeek Harness，让 Agent 直接看消息、自己决定怎么回，插件不代答。

description.en: A local-first research workspace for DeepSeek Harness: PDF annotations, AI reading, citations, knowledge graphs, LaTeX and slides.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里管文献：PDF 批注、AI 精读、引文整理、知识图谱，还能写 LaTeX 和做幻灯片。

description.en: DSH 记忆插件：jieba/1-gram 分词 + 向量混合检索，IDF 实词闸门（无关查询宁可不注入），三层注入（常驻 / 动态 / 工具按需），冻结策略保前缀缓存命中，四 Tab 管理面板
description.zh: 给 DSH 加长期记忆：混合检索加相关性闸门，无关内容不乱塞，还能省缓存。

description.en: A ZCode-styled skin for DSH Web: Zai light/dark themes, sidebar workspace session tree, global search, turn navigation with hover wave, and approval-card / message-keycap styling aligned to ZCode — every visual value guarded by contract assertions. A fork of MichengAI/dsh-codex-ui; do not install it alongside the upstream plugin — both repaint the same sidebar and conversation surfaces.
description.zh: 把 DSH Web 界面换成 ZCode 视觉语言的皮肤：Zai 明暗主题、侧栏工作区会话树、全局搜索、带悬停波的轮次导航、对齐 ZCode 的审批卡与消息键帽样式，每个视觉值都有契约断言守护。本项目是 MichengAI/dsh-codex-ui 的分支，请勿与上游同装——两者都会重绘同一套侧栏与会话界面。

description.en: AIGC creation inside DeepSeek Harness: generate images, video, audio and 3D with open and closed-source models — parameter schemas, cost estimates, approval gates and a task panel.
description.zh: 把 AIGC 创作直接放进 DeepSeek Harness：用开源与闭源模型生成图像、视频、音频与 3D，含参数 schema、费用预估、审批与任务面板。

description.en: Animated deepseek girl desktop pet plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面加个会动的 deepseek 娘桌宠，陪你聊天解闷。

description.en: 用于DeepseekHarness的主题插件
description.zh: 给 DSH 界面换上《蔚蓝档案》阿罗娜主题，亮暗双配色、可换壁纸、玻璃输入区和标题栏贴图都安排上了。

description.en: Remote-control your local DeepSeek Harness from a phone through your own zero-knowledge relay: phone-first page, QR pairing, end-to-end encryption, approvals, full desktop UI fallback.
DeepSeek Harness plugin: model hub. DSH-native sign-in (Claude, Codex, Copilot, OpenRouter, xAI, Kimi), rocco GPU dispatch, per-model cost, spend caps, prompt-cache checks, and the dsh-hub CLI.
description.zh: 把 DSH 变成模型中枢：一键登录各家模型、按模型算成本、设花费上限，还能调度 GPU。

description.en: DSH-QQ bot 插件（OneBot v11 / NapCat）for DeepSeek Harness：人设、记忆、心情、学习表、联网、看b站，自带网页控制台。
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 接入 QQ，机器人有人设、记忆和心情，还能发图发卡，自带网页控制台。

description.en: Inline diff cards for every edit, write and str_replace_editor call: old/new line numbers, character-level highlighting, 57-language detection with a red/green-safe syntax palette, a side-by-side viewer, Read-row line ranges, and a settings page for display style and highlighting.
description.zh: 为 edit、write、str_replace_editor 调用就地渲染内联差异卡片：旧/新行号、字符级高亮、57 种语言检测与红绿安全的语法配色，另有左右对照、Read 行范围，以及可配置的显示风格与高亮设置。

description.en: Fork of Yuuz12/dsh-webui-auth adding a deny-by-default allowlist route gate over resources, plugin bundles, /api and WebSocket upgrades; password and OIDC/SSO login with an SSO-only mode; server-side sessions with HttpOnly cookies plus a per-browser session list and selective revocation; an OAuth 2.1 device authorization flow (RFC 8628) for app and CLI access, with independent device sessions that expire only on explicit revocation; and a core session bridge that exchanges the launch cookie on the server without exposing the launch token. It is a fork of Yuuz12/dsh-webui-auth and cannot be installed alongside it — remove the original from the profile's bundle list first.
description.zh: Yuuz12/dsh-webui-auth 的分支，新增默认拒绝的白名单路由闸门（资源、插件 bundle、/api、WebSocket 升级）；密码与 OIDC/SSO 登录及「仅允许 SSO」模式；服务端会话 + HttpOnly Cookie，浏览器会话列表与单条吊销；面向 App/CLI 的 OAuth 2.1 设备授权（RFC 8628），设备会话独立、仅主动吊销失效；核心会话桥在服务端换取 launch Cookie，不向客户端暴露 launch token。 本插件是 Yuuz12/dsh-webui-auth 的分支，不能与原版同装——安装前请先从 profile 的 bundle 列表移除原版。

description.en: DSH plugin: read and write DingTalk AI Tables through the official dws CLI, adding ten DingTalk AI Table tools (nine `dingtalk_aitable_*` plus `dingtalk_sync_job`), a settings panel, and scheduled CSV export.
description.zh: DSH 插件：包装钉钉官方 dws CLI，读写钉钉 AI 表格，提供 10 个钉钉 AI 表格工具（9 个 `dingtalk_aitable_*` 加 1 个 `dingtalk_sync_job`）、设置面板与定时 CSV 导出。

description.en: AI 驱动的法律行业案件管理与 Agent 工具：诉讼案件 / 非诉项目 / 任务中心 / 期限引擎 / 技能与 MCP，Agent 预设直接办案，运行于 DeepSeek Harness。

Multi-pet tank for DSH: every active top-level conversation gets its own companion at once. Animation and status bubbles show real work phases; model-based palettes and tok/s-driven running distinguish models and vendors; the conversation menu keeps a chosen pet on screen after its result is viewed. Shared feeding, affinity and naming keep the tank one workflow. A fork of zhu1090093659/dsh-pet (Apache-2.0); both register the same pet bundle row, so the two cannot be installed together.
description.zh: DSH 一池多宠桌宠：所有活跃顶层会话同时各有一只宠物，不用切会话就能看到整条工作队列。动作与状态气泡显示真实工作阶段，模型配色与 tok/s 跑速区分模型/供应商；会话菜单「专属宠物保持」让指定对话的宠物在结果查看、切走后也不回收，多宠共享喂食、亲密度与命名。基于 zhu1090093659/dsh-pet（Apache-2.0）改造，两者注册同一个 pet bundle 行，不能与上游同装。

description.en: A research library panel and skill set for DSH: project folders, figures with registered provenance, drafts, references, data tables, journal profiles and submissions, plus writing, citation and Origin-plotting discipline for research agents.
description.zh: 给 DSH 的科研库面板与技能组：课题目录、带溯源的图表登记、草稿、文献、数据表、期刊档案、投稿台账，以及面向科研智能体的写作、引用与 Origin 出图纪律（出图需另装 dsh-origin-plugin）。

description.en: Read-only SQLite store for the DeepSeek Harness code-graph seam — serves structural queries from the schema-v4 graph at .codegraph/codegraph.db, the same on-disk format the codegraph CLI writes

Humanized fork of @xmanrui/dsh-im (base 4.38.0) for DeepSeek Harness: humanized message delivery (send delay + typing two-phase), message_break + streaming coexistence, status reactions, reply quotes, per-bot overrides, and a no_reply reclaim tool. @xmanr
IFC model quantity take-off with CSV export for quantity checking.
description.zh: IFC 模型工程量提取与 CSV 导出核对。

description.en: Manage Claude Code, Codex and Grok CLIs inside dsh and dispatch tasks to them as headless subagents, with dsh models, skills and tools bridged into each task, resumable CLI subsessions, and a hierarchical task board in the right sidebar (the board tab requires the separate DSH-better-sidebar plugin; without it the tab is not registered).
description.zh: 在 dsh 中管理 Claude Code / Codex / Grok CLI，并把任务派发给它们作为子智能体执行：dsh 的模型、技能与工具随任务桥接，CLI 子会话可回放续聊，右侧栏提供分层任务看板（看板 tab 需另装 DSH-better-sidebar 插件，未安装时不会注册）。

description.en: WSL World for DeepSeek Harness: the whole session runs in a local WSL distribution with Linux paths, clean PATH, native @/search/diffs/worktrees, plus a connection panel and project doctor. Not a wsl_* tool set.

Kill AI Slop for DSH — score a received document on three weighted axes (expression, execution, decision), audit work-slop with a delivery-obligation ledger, and machine-verify every quote against the source. Reads docx, pptx, xlsx, pdf, txt, md, csv, json and html. Zero runtime dependencies, zero network, fully local.
description.zh: AI垃圾过滤（Kill AI Slop）：给收到的文件打一个可回溯的体检得分（表达／执行／决策三维加权），用交付承接台账审查工作空转，每条引文回原文机器复核；支持 docx/pptx/xlsx/pdf/txt/md/csv/json/html。零运行依赖、零联网、纯本地计算。

description.en: Estimates what each conversation costs, with built-in official prices from 16 vendors (DeepSeek peak/off-peak hours and long-context tiers included), a breakdown panel with a currency picker under the composer, and each conversation's cost in the sidebar.
description.zh: 估算每个对话的费用：内置 16 家厂商的官方价格（含 DeepSeek 高峰/空闲时段和长上下文阶梯价），输入框下方可展开明细并切换币种，侧边栏显示每个对话的费用。

description.en: 「对话管理」全局面板页（浏览器半）：会话与统计两层 Tabs——会话视图给出全量会话（含已归档）的搜索、分页、归档 / 取消归档 / 导出 / 删除、导入为新会话与整理数据（孤儿回收 + 统计重算），统计视图给出全部对话的 token 用量。
QMS NCR, CAPA and 8D tracking with batch and impact assessment.
description.zh: QMS 不合格品、CAPA 与 8D 闭环跟踪。

description.en: MailHarbor: a multi-account IMAP/SMTP mail workspace for DeepSeek Harness with local backup, AI search and compose, CalDAV tasks and reports.
DSH Web 插件：右侧栏预览并控制 Android / iOS 模拟器 / HarmonyOS 设备与模拟器
DSH plugin: a four-entry learning flow in the session input bar — scaffold a preset, collect candidates, merge reviewed changes, and run a read-only workspace audit.
description.zh: DSH 插件：会话输入区的四入口学习流程——初始预设、收集提炼、关联升级、沉淀复用。

description.en: 自动识别 Steam 壁纸引擎（Wallpaper Engine，工坊 431960）里的壁纸并导入 DeepSeek Harness 作为背景：视频/网页/场景分别处理，内置 Relax Ambience [4K] 默认壁纸；支持鼠标滑动涟漪特效（WebGL 水面高度场、波峰扩散、折射壁纸 + 镜面高光，移植自 github.com/Yaki-Blake/mouse-ripple，上游 sirxemic/jquery.ripples，MIT）与性能显示。安装后需完全退出并重启 DSH，右下角的「壁纸」按

Keeps prompt caches warm for OpenCode Go DeepSeek conversations by predicting each request's cache hit before it is sent, rotating the x-opencode-session routing id when that request would be cold and recent requests are slow, and pooling idle warm ids for reuse by new conversations.
description.zh: 为 OpenCode Go 的 DeepSeek 会话保持提示缓存命中：在请求发出前预测其缓存命中率，当该请求预计变冷且近期请求偏慢时轮换 x-opencode-session 路由 id，并把空闲的暖 id 放入池中供新会话复用。

description.en: DSH plugin: a settings panel to list, add, rewrite and toggle @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client MCP rows — no more hand-writing them into cordis.patch.yml. Zero build, zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: DSH 插件：一块设置面板管理 @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client 的 MCP 行——列出、新增、改写、启停，不必再手写 cordis.patch.yml；零构建、零运行依赖。

description.en: Fetches AOSP source snapshots from codeload and searches them on the device with ripgrep through nine tools covering mirror listing, preset bundles, fetch, incremental update, cross-module regex search, a heuristic call-chain trace and line reads, with no git, no root and no build.
description.zh: 从 codeload 拉 AOSP 源码快照，在本机用 ripgrep 检索，九个工具覆盖镜像列表、预设包、拉取、增量更新、跨模块正则搜索、启发式调用链追踪与按行读取，不需要 git、root 或编译。

description.en: A Windows QQ character development preview for DeepSeek Harness with persona injection and a local control panel; full setup requires companion services.
description.zh: Windows 上的 DSH QQ 角色开发预览，提供人设注入与本地控制台，完整部署需另配本机服务。

description.en: 大肥鱼语音播报（桌宠音色版）：模型一有输出，就让 dsh-pet 用它自己配置的音色念出来
description.zh: 让 dsh-pet 桌宠用你设置好的音色，把模型输出直接念出来，不用另配语音引擎。

description.en: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接使用 Claude Code、Codex、PI、OMP 等 Agent CLI
description.zh: 在 DSH 里直接调用 Claude Code、Codex 等各类 Agent CLI，不用切窗口就能干活

description.en: 自包含 DSH 陪伴插件：五区可塑人格、七层记忆、上下文压缩、记忆合并、B 站文风学习、陪伴分寸与心声；零额外模型调用，省 token。A self-contained DSH companion plugin: five-region persona, seven-layer memory, compression, memory merge, style learning, token-frugal by design.
description.zh: 给 AI 装上五区人格和七层记忆，越聊越懂你，还能省 token 的陪伴插件。

description.en: 把钉钉 AI 表格接入 DeepSeek Harness ｜ 10 个工具 + 设置面板 + 定时导出 ｜ Read & write DingTalk AI Tables from DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 把钉钉 AI 表格接进 DeepSeek Harness，读写数据、定时导出，10 个工具加设置面板。

description.en: Layered context compression for DeepSeek Harness: folds old turns into model-written L1–L3 summary blocks, maps what each layer holds, and wakes the model when the context crosses a size line or keeps growing. By default it requires DSH's experimental Session Search plugin (session_event_read / session_event_search); without it the tools stay disabled unless requireSessionQuery is turned off.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的分层上下文压缩插件：把旧轮次折成由模型撰写摘要的 L1–L3 块，在地图里显示每层占用与可压位置，并在占用越过提醒线或持续增长时叫醒模型决定是否压缩。默认需要启用 DSH 实验性插件「会话搜索」（session_event_read / session_event_search），否则 compress 与 context_map 会停用（可关闭 requireSessionQuery）。

description.en: 用于在dsh中播放自己想听的音乐
description.zh: 在 DSH 里直接导入并播放本地音乐，带黑胶唱片动画和频谱律动，边干活边听歌。

description.en: Verified current-source search workflow for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一套带来源核验的实时搜索流程，搜到的信息更新更可信。

description.en: fx-tui — Interactive terminal UI for DeepSeek Harness (dsh). An out-of-tree Ink/React bundle plugin: streaming markdown, tool cards, approval memory, plan review, session/model switching.
description.zh: 给 dsh 套一个交互式终端界面，流式输出、工具卡片、审批记忆和计划审阅都在终端里搞定。

description.en: DSH 插件：本地加密凭据库 + 无头浏览器登录态 + 带登录态抓取（贴吧/NGA/Pixiv/书屋），含浏览器密码迁移与设置页
description.zh: 本地加密存账号，无头浏览器自动登录，帮 agent 抓贴吧、NGA、Pixiv 等登录墙后的内容。

description.en: 紫微斗数 Pro · DSH 插件：确定性排盘 + 紫微师解读（紫微师 / 金聚）
description.zh: 确定性紫微斗数排盘加面板内直接解读，前面看盘后面聊，命盘分析一步到位。

description.en: Adds a browserless deepseek-web provider that drives chat.deepseek.com, with an account pool (rotation, cooldown, auto-failover), in-panel login (browser, or email + password with MFA) and token usage stats.
description.zh: 把 chat.deepseek.com 网页版接成 deepseek-web provider：纯 HTTP 无浏览器，多账号轮换/冷却/自动切换，插件内登录（浏览器，或邮箱+密码+验证码），带 token 用量统计。

description.en: Adds an auto-hiding icon rail to the collapsed macOS Desktop sidebar, with workspace pinning and flyouts for recent sessions, scheduled tasks, user-installed plugins and account information.
description.zh: 为 macOS Desktop 折叠侧栏添加自动隐藏的图标轨，支持工作区置顶，以及最近会话、定时任务、用户安装插件和账号信息浮层。

description.en: Injects a per-conversation x-opencode-session header for OpenCode Go routes that were registered under a custom provider name, through the host official llm-pi-ai/request-headers waterfall. Zero dependencies, no fetch patching, and it never overwrites a header someone else already set.
description.zh: 为以自定义供应商名接入的 OpenCode Go 路由，按会话注入 x-opencode-session 请求头：走宿主官方 llm-pi-ai/request-headers 瀑布；零依赖、不替换 fetch，且不覆盖他人已写入的同名头。

description.en: HS code classification consistency check: chapter, heading, subheading and code hierarchy.
description.zh: HS 编码归类层级一致性核对：章、品目、子目与商品编号层级。

description.en: ComfyUI studio in a DSH sidebar panel: connects to a local or LAN ComfyUI server, picks saved image workflows, cleans and rewrites prompts, edits LoRAs and nodes, generates images, and previews results with copyable seeds.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏里的 ComfyUI 工作室：连接本机或局域网 ComfyUI，选择已保存的图片工作流，清理/改写提示词、编辑 LoRA 与节点、生成图片并预览结果，可复制种子。

description.en: HAZOP worksheet check: node, guide word, process parameter, deviation and cause, plus required fields and locally configured risk levels.
description.zh: HAZOP 分析表核对：节点、引导词、工艺参数、偏差与原因，以及必填栏目与本机构风险等级口径。

description.en: Immersive weather theme for DeepSeek Harness: physical rain with splashes and ripples, snow in two crystal habits, a hearth, lightning with distance-coded thunder, a night mode, and a compact control panel.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供沉浸式天气主题：按物理模拟的雨滴（含溅射与水花）、两种晶型的雪花、炉火，以及带分叉的闪电与按距离延迟的雷声，并提供夜间模式和紧凑控制面板。

description.en: NSFC grant application format and anonymization check against the annual guidelines.
description.zh: 国自然申请书形式审查与匿名化核对。

description.en: Legal citation check: statute name, article number, text and validity status.
description.zh: 法条引用名称、条号、原文与效力状态核对。

description.en: OTA guest-review reply ledger check: content and score, reply deadlines, responder, issue category and duplicate review ids.
description.zh: OTA 点评回复台账核对：点评内容与评分、回复时限、回复人、问题分类与编号重复。

description.en: Letter of credit document check against UCP600: documents, periods and discrepancies.
description.zh: 信用证单据与 UCP600 不符点核对。

description.en: Adds next-message prediction, inline draft completion, and prompt optimization to the DSH composer, with a call budget, request stats, and glossary protection in Settings. A fork of Somnus678/dsh-input-assistant; both put their controls on the same composer, so do not install the two together.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框中提供下一句预测、输入续写和提示词优化，并在设置页提供调用额度、请求统计和术语保护。基于 Somnus678/dsh-input-assistant 改造的分支，两者都在同一个输入框上加控件，不能与上游同装。

description.en: Rider-Waite-Smith tarot for DSH with a right-dock table for the Celtic Cross, Waite's alternative and thirty-five-card methods, plain draws, and three- or nine-card layouts; the plugin handles drawing and placement, then turns each card into the conversation for model interpretation from Waite's Pictorial Key.
description.zh: DSH 的莱德-韦特-史密斯塔罗牌插件，在右侧栏提供凯尔特十字、韦特的替代与三十五张牌方法、普通抽牌以及三张牌和九张牌布局；插件负责抽牌与摆放，再将每张翻开的牌逐轮送入对话，由模型依据韦特《塔罗图解》进行解读。

description.en: Connect one or more Feishu bot apps to the local DeepSeek Harness (DSH): each bot app is a channel with its own model, workspace, permissions and private-chat allowlist, and every chat under it gets its own DSH session. Derived from MichengAI/dsh-im-connect (Apache-2.0) with the other IM channels removed and identifiers renamed so both can be installed side by side.
description.zh: 把一个或多个飞书机器人应用接入本机 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）：每个机器人应用是一条频道，各自独立的模型、工作区、权限与私聊准入；频道下的每个私聊/群聊各有一条独立的 DSH 会话。基于 MichengAI/dsh-im-connect（Apache-2.0）改造，删去其它 IM 通道并重命名标识，因此可与上游同装。

description.en: SPC control-chart and Cpk check against the current GB/T 17989.2—2020 control-chart constants.
description.zh: 按现行 GB/T 17989.2—2020 控制图常数表核对 SPC 控制图控制限与 CPK。

description.en: Project document chain integrity check: stage order, completeness and amount parseability.
description.zh: 项目全流程文件链条核对：环节顺序、文件齐备与金额可解析。

description.en: Local model scheduler for DSH on Windows 10/11 with DSH Desktop 0.2.x: a bundled console for engine/model import, VRAM estimation, load/close, and an OpenAI-compatible gateway.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的本地模型调度插件（仅 Windows 10/11，需 DSH Desktop 0.2.x），内置控制台，支持引擎/模型导入、显存预估、加载关闭和 OpenAI 兼容网关。

description.en: DSH 插件：在侧边栏常驻显示阿里云代金券余额，支持多账号、历史曲线与 Agent 工具
description.zh: 侧边栏常驻显示阿里云代金券余额，支持多账号切换和历史曲线，还能让 Agent 帮你查余额。

description.en: DSH-Enhance — DSH 插件：对话删除、工作区迁移、搜索/抓取多平台优先-候补替换
description.zh: 给 DSH 加上会话删除、会话迁移和搜索换源，删得干净、搬得顺手、搜不到就自动换下一个源。

description.en: 代际树面板：Lead→成员→孙代理 层级实时组织树 + 团队焦点 + 真状态点 + 模型路由中心
description.zh: 把 Lead、成员和孙代理的层级关系画成实时组织树，一眼看清团队结构和每个代理的真实状态。
敏感操作和AI提问都能发邮件通知你，回封邮件就能批准、拒绝或作答，不用守着电脑。

description.en: 记账插件 / A bookkeeping and expense-tracker plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH Web).
description.zh: 给 DSH Web 加个记账本面板，随手记收支、按月汇总分类统计，还能让 AI 在对话里直接记账查账。

description.en: 把浏览器收藏夹接进 DeepSeek Harness：书脊书架 + 无限层级分类 + 搜索 + 卡片详情（DSH 插件）
description.zh: 把浏览器收藏夹搬进 DSH 侧栏，用书脊书架分类整理、搜索和查看书签详情。

description.en: Branch map for long engineering conversations in DeepSeek Harness: mainline/tree views, fork comparison, conclusion merge, context editing, derived sessions.
description.zh: 给长工程对话加分支地图，能看主线树状图、对比分叉、合并结论、改上下文，还能派生新会话。

description.en: Screenshot in, working UI out: several agents rebuild the same reference interface in parallel, and you adopt the live result you like best. A DeepSeek Harness plugin.
description.zh: 上传一张界面截图，多个 Agent 并行复刻出可运行的前端页面，挑最顺眼的直接用。

description.en: Command Code usage panel for DeepSeek Harness: credits, 5-hour/weekly windows, request stats, plan tiers, API key editor; Settings tab + draggable floating capsule
description.zh: 在 DSH 里随时查看 Command Code 的额度、用量窗口和请求统计，还能管理 API Key。

description.en: 可配置的上下文压缩插件：总压缩 / 思考压缩 / 工具输出压缩，带左栏面板（DeepSeek Harness）
description.zh: 给 DSH 用的上下文压缩插件，总压缩、思考压缩、工具输出压缩分开管，左栏面板点一点就调好。

description.en: 让 dsh-fish 里的她做梦：安静够久之后，把真实发生过的事重新拼一场
description.zh: 让 dsh-fish 里的她安静久了就做一场梦，把真实发生过的事重新拼成梦的种子，醒来后自己讲完。

description.en: Font settings plugin for DeepSeek Harness: per-role (interface / content / code) font family and weight pickers with local font scanning. DeepSeek Harness 字体设置插件
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面分别设置界面、正文、代码的字体和字重，还能扫描本地字体。

description.en: 大肥鱼游戏 Agent：观众指令、自主操作、自动续局与可追溯对局复盘
description.zh: 把游戏操作交给 AI Agent，观众指令优先，自动续局还能复盘每局决策。

description.en: DeepHippo — Hyper-Neural Memory Terminal: a 3D WebGL brain + long-term memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh)
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加个 3D 大脑可视化界面，把长期记忆存起来随时调用。

description.en: DSH 插件：AI垃圾过滤 Ai Slop/Work Slop —— 给收到的文件打可回溯的「体检得分」（表达／执行／决策三维加权），用义务台账审查工作空转，每条引文机器复核原文。零依赖·零联网·纯本地。DeepSeek Harness plugin: score documents for AI-slop and work-slop.
description.zh: 给收到的文件打个可追溯的体检分，揪出AI注水和无效空转，每条结论都能回查原文。

description.en: 一个跑在 DeepSeek Harness 输入区的学习插件：把「收集 → 提炼 → 关联 → 升级 → 沉淀 → 复用」做成有交互引导、预设管理、审核入库与体系体检的运行时能力。DeepSeek Harness plugin: a four-entry learning workspace.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入区里搭一套学习工作流，从收集到复用全程引导，还能审核入库和体检。

description.en: Literature watch for DeepSeek Harness: save named Crossref bibliographic queries with time windows, run them against Crossref with a bounded client, keep a seen-DOI store so repeated runs return only genuinely new items, and render a Markdown digest plus SARIF. A watch reports new DOIs in a search window, not relevance or quality.
description.zh: 给 Crossref 文献检索设好时间窗口并记住看过的 DOI，重复运行只返回真正的新文章，还能生成 Markdown 摘要。

description.en: Task ETA + progress chip for DeepSeek Harness: elapsed time, self-calibrating remaining-time range and its empirical probability. Zero extra model calls.
description.zh: 在输入框旁实时显示任务已运行时间和预计剩余区间，让等待有依据、不靠猜。

description.en: 大肥鱼直播工作室：DSH 虚拟主播、弹幕语音互动、Live2D 桥接与直播账本
description.zh: 接B站弹幕做虚拟主播，能语音互动、Live2D上镜，还顺手记下模型消耗和礼物账。

description.en: 每天 00:00 把自己名下以 DSH 开头的插件仓库打上 dsh-plugin topic（缺 cordis 标记自动补），让 dsh.market 自动收录。零依赖，不调用模型。
description.zh: 每天零点自动给名下 DSH 开头的插件仓库打上 dsh-plugin 标签，让 dsh.market 自动收录你的新插件。

description.en: DSH 插件：在「设置 → 侧栏」管理 MCP 客户端服务器的面板（零构建、零运行依赖）。DeepSeek Harness plugin: a settings panel to manage MCP client rows.
description.zh: 在设置面板里管理 MCP 客户端服务器，增删改查和启停都能搞定，保存即生效不用重启。

description.en: 专为 DeepSeek Desktop (DSH) 打造的轻量级、自进化长期记忆引擎。零网络纯本地极速快环 (p95 < 1ms) + 严格风控离线自愈慢环。
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Desktop 加一个纯本地的长期记忆，能自己进化，不用联网也能秒级记住和找回对话内容。

description.en: Suggested next-step prompts under every finished agent turn in the DeepSeek Harness chat — one click sends the followup.
description.zh: 每轮对话结束后自动给出下一步提示词，点一下就能直接发送，省去手动输入。
给 AI 加个副脑，边干活边孵化主脑，多包配合实现记忆与观察。
给 DSH 宿主加一层适配和看门狗，能发现异常、自动降级并记录崩溃现场。

description.en: DSH plugin + bundled HID toolkit for the Halo PixelBar desktop pixel display (text / scenes / colors / ambient light / volume)
description.zh: 在 DSH 里一句话控制花再 Halo PixelBar 桌面像素屏，推文字、切场景、改屏色、调氛围灯和音量。

description.en: A fifth DeepSeek Harness work mode that requires a falsification design (at least two pieces of evidence that could disprove the plan) in every plan and tags each factual claim with its source (\[文件]/\[检索]/\[记忆]) or \[未知]; evidence grading follows the project's AGENTS.md.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 增加第五个工作模式：每个计划必须含「证伪设计」（至少两条能推翻方案的证据），每条事实须标来源（\[文件]/\[检索]/\[记忆]）或 \[未知]；取证分级按项目 AGENTS.md 执行。

description.en: DSH Web 插件：右侧栏快捷指令库，点一下带进下一条消息，按会话每轮自动注入
description.zh: 把常用提示词存成侧栏卡片，点一下带进下一条消息，还能按会话每轮自动注入。

description.en: 本地出口代理（egress）桥：给只接受无凭据代理地址的消费方一个本地地址，账号密码在上游那一跳注入。失败即断联，无直连降级。 | DSH plugin: a local egress proxy that hands a credential-free proxy URL to consumers that reject credentials, then injects the upstream auth on the hop that needs it. Fail-closed — no direct fallback, ever.
description.zh: 给只认无凭据代理地址的客户端一个本地入口，账号密码在上游那一跳自动补上，连不上就直接断，不偷偷走直连。

description.en: 大肥鱼陪看工作室：持续观察、自主反应、暂停分析与离线视频制作，支持 DSH 和 Live2D
description.zh: 让 AI 陪你看片：边看边攒剧情，自主决定继续看、吐槽或暂停分析，再合成带语音字幕和 Live2D 的完整视频。

description.en: Two-way remote control for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在本地 DSH 窗口里直接用原生界面远程操作另一台电脑上的 DSH，双向控制不套远程桌面。

description.en: 记忆自动放行 + AI 预审 + 审批集中预览 + 右侧栏 diff/撤销，把归属写成事实的 DSH 审批中枢
description.zh: 给 DSH 加一层审批大脑：能自动放行的自动放，该问你的才问，事后还能查、能撤回。

description.en: Simple dsh router for rust token killer.
description.zh: 把每次 bash 工具调用都交给 RTK 精简处理，帮你在日常命令里省下大量 token。

description.en: A recycle bin for DeepSeek Harness sessions: a red menu row moves a session into a 3-day bin that can be restored or purged from the sidebar foot.
description.zh: 给 DSH 会话加个回收站，删掉的会话保留 3 天，随时能恢复或彻底清掉。

description.en: Title every DeepSeek Harness session from the work it actually did, and keep it current as later rounds move it on.
description.zh: 根据会话实际做的事自动起标题，并随后续对话持续更新，让侧边栏始终显示准确内容。

description.en: Configurable session titles with custom prompts, refresh policies, local topic-drift detection, and single-session or historical title regeneration.
description.zh: 可配置的会话标题生成，支持自定义提示词、刷新策略、本地话题漂移检测，以及单条会话和历史标题重建。

description.en: DSH plugin: download watermark-free Douyin videos, transcribe with local or cloud ASR, proofread, and export Markdown/SRT/VTT/JSON/HTML/DOCX.
description.zh: 一键下载抖音无水印视频，自动转写校对文字，并导出多种格式文稿。

description.en: DSH closing-animation plugin: a companion to dsh-startup-screen that plays a video and end card when you exit the web UI
description.zh: 给 DSH 网页加退出动画，点电源按钮就全屏播放你指定的视频，播完自动关标签页。

description.en: 会记住你卡在哪的 DSH 学习陪练 · roadmap in settings, state on disk, mastery by unprompted output
description.zh: 会记住你卡在哪的学习陪练，按路线推进、记录进度，靠你的实际产出判断是否学会。

description.en: Social Trace：微博与雪球增量监控、可视化拓扑、历史缓存与本地检索
description.zh: 把微博、雪球博主的新动态自动存到本地，还能推送到QQ或微信，随时翻查。

description.en: 面向个人的 AI 学习系统：多会话分工、文件记忆、学科插件（DSH 插件包）
description.zh: 给 DSH 装个「总规划」：自动排周计划、分科下发任务，进度存文件里，关窗换会话都不丢。

description.en: Composer dock monitor for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): Context brick matrix, per-turn net upload/download Tokens, and 200ms native macOS CPU, GPU, and MEM bar charts.
description.zh: 在输入框旁实时显示上下文占用、每轮 Token 流量和 macOS 的 CPU、GPU、内存占用，点开就能看详情。

description.en: DSH plugin menu with client, workspace and session scopes | 分级插件菜单
description.zh: 按工作区和会话分别开关 DSH 插件，不同项目、不同会话各用各的配置，互不干扰。

description.en: Per-session draggable todo sticky note for DeepSeek Harness: short-term tasks, a long-term plan with real phase progress, and three todo_note_* tools so the agent and you share the same note.
description.zh: 给每个 DSH 会话配一块可拖动的待办便签，短期待办和长期规划进度一目了然，还能和 agent 共享同一份笔记。
一句话小问题自动交给网页版 DeepSeek 回答，不用 API 和 Key，省时又省钱。
每周固定时间把 DSH 的 token 用量和工作汇总自动发到你邮箱，没开机下次启动补发。

description.en: ZCode 风格的工作流时间线面板：横向/纵向响应式、表情状态机小脸、阶段级模型/并发配置、右栏子代理对话、历史持久化。
description.zh: 把工作流阶段推进和子代理状态画成实时时间线，一眼看清进度和完成情况

description.en: Live hardware and token telemetry for DeepSeek Harness: GPU and CPU load, VRAM, temperature, power, energy, generation speed and context fill of the current session.
description.zh: 实时查看 GPU、CPU、显存、温度、功耗和 token 用量，随时掌握当前会话的硬件状态和上下文占用。

description.en: 科研写作模式 · DSH Agent 预设：75 个技能随仓库分发（另有 7 个按许可由脚本拉取，合计 82），覆盖选题、文献检索与精读、综述、中文毕业论文、英文期刊写作、引用格式、审稿与去 AI 痕
description.zh: 装上它，Agent 就变成科研写作助手：查真文献、精读做笔记、写中英文论文、套引用格式，还绝不编造文献。

description.en: AI 小梦做的 DSH 插件仓库｜dsh-skill-jnkgg 技能库管家：大技能库省 token 不丢技能，目录限量 + 正文按需加载 + 中文关键词直达
description.zh: 把任意目录的 Agent Skills 挂进 DSH，目录限量省 token，正文按需加载，中文关键词直达

description.en: Floating todo panel in the DSH Web UI — a draggable window that snaps to any screen edge, today/more grouping in the home tab, a separate all-items tab with uncompleted/completed filters and incremental loading, items that open read-only with an edit toggle in the corner, image attachments that zoom in place and other files that download, a pomodoro timer (15/30/45/60 or custom, with configurable rounds and break interval) that sends a Windows notification and waits for confirmation before the next phase, and five agent tools plus a /todo slash command for reading and editing the list.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 的浮动待办面板——窗口可拖动并吸附屏幕四边，首页按「今天/更多」分组，另有全部事项标签页（未完成/已完成筛选、增量加载），条目默认只读查看、点右上角「编辑」才可修改，图片附件点击放大、其它附件点击下载，内置番茄钟（15/30/45/60 或自定义，可设轮数与休息间隔）到点推送 Windows 通知并在进入下一阶段前等待确认，另提供 5 个 agent 工具与 /todo 斜杠命令读写任务。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 学术研究 preset + download-paper 技能：多源文献检索、知网空间→主站链接映射、HTML/XLSX/BibTeX/RIS/arXiv 脚本五件套交付
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加个学术研究助手，多源搜文献、核验去重，一键导出 HTML、XLSX、BibTeX、RIS 和 arXiv 脚本。

description.en: DSH 插件：在输入框旁设定延时或指定时间，向当前会话发送一条消息（默认「继续」）https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-send-later
description.zh: 在输入框旁设个延时或指定时间，到点自动给当前会话发条消息，默认发「继续」，省得手动催。

description.en: Second-model gate on the assistant turn, installed in two parts: copy engine/ into ~/.dsh/plugins/ and mount it by absolute path in the profile patch (the bundle itself only installs the settings panel), then switch off the default dry-run mode that only logs verdicts. Once active, a separate judge call scores the draft against the numbered criteria (0-10 each); any criterion under 6 fails the turn and sends it back for a rewrite, up to 3 rounds by default. The web panel edits criteria and thresholds, and every verdict is appended to an audit log.
description.zh: 助手回合收口前的第二模型质检，分两步安装：先把 engine/ 拷到 ~/.dsh/plugins/ 并在 profile 的 patch 中按绝对路径挂载（bundle 本身只装设置面板），再关掉默认的演习模式（只记日志、不打回）。启用后由独立判官调用按编号判据逐条打 0-10 分，任一条低于 6 分即判不合格并打回重写，默认最多回炉 3 轮；Web 面板编辑判据与阈值，每次判定写入审计日志。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) bundle that registers the REA (Reverse Engineer Anything) MCP server as mcp__rea__* tools — third-party adapter
description.zh: 把 REA 逆向工程 MCP 服务器接进 DSH，让你直接调用工具拆解分析任意目标。

description.en: Command Code LLM provider for DSH Desktop: registers the commandcode route with a live model catalog, configurable request and stream-idle timeouts, multi-account rotation on 429/401, plan-aware model filtering, an OAuth login flow and a bilingual usage and billing panel. Derived from Mars-Sea/dsh-commandcode-provider (MIT); both register the same commandcode route, so do not install both.
description.zh: 把 Command Code 接入 DSH Desktop 的模型提供商插件：注册 commandcode 路由，带实时模型目录、可配置的请求与流式空闲超时、429/401 自动多账户轮换、按套餐过滤模型、OAuth 登录流程，以及中英双语的用量与计费面板。派生自 Mars-Sea/dsh-commandcode-provider（MIT），两者注册同一个 commandcode 路由，不能与上游同装。

description.en: Installs and runs Android native command-line tools from inside DSH: fetches aarch64 bionic packages from the Termux repository, unpacks them in pure JS and runs them through /system/bin/linker64, with no root, no Shizuku and no external package manager.
description.zh: 在 DSH 内部安装并运行 Android 原生命令行工具：从 Termux 仓库取 aarch64 bionic 包、纯 JS 解包，再经 /system/bin/linker64 执行，无需 root、Shizuku 或外部包管理器。

description.en: One image behind the whole DSH shell. The image layer sits at z-index -1 and the shell's two --dsw-* tokens are repointed at translucent tints, so the picture shows through the frame, sidebar and composer. Ships a bundled default picture so it works with zero configuration, plus a floating panel with five sliders, presets, upload, and an SSRF-guarded URL import; changes persist to a local settings.json and the client self-heals when the SPA replaces its stylesheet.
description.zh: 给整个 DSH 外壳铺一张背景图：图片层挂在 z-index -1，并把外壳的两个 --dsw-* 令牌改成半透明色，让背景透出侧栏、中栏和输入框。内置一张默认图，装完零配置就有；右下角浮动面板提供五个滑杆、预设档、上传与带 SSRF 防护的链接导入，改动写进本地 settings.json，样式表被 SPA 顶掉时会自动重画。

description.en: Five-layer persona (L1–L5), event memory with FTS5 plus Dice retrieval, cognitive filter, skill cards with auto-frozen asset packs, millisecond reflex rules, three-tier safety degradation, a read-only brain star map, and an optional VPet-Simulator MOD bridge.
description.zh: 五层人格（L1–L5）、事件记忆（FTS5 与 Dice 混合检索）、认知滤网、技能卡与自固化资产包、毫秒级条件反射、三档安全降级、只读脑星图，另附可选的 VPet-Simulator 桌宠 MOD 桥。

description.en: Lists RouterAI prompt and completion prices for the profile models, highlighting the active one. Requires a model provider whose config key is `routerai`; without it the table shows no data.
description.zh: 列出 profile 里各模型的 RouterAI 提示与补全价格，并高亮当前在用的那个。需要配置键为 `routerai` 的模型 provider；缺了表格不显示数据。

description.en: What it does while she sleeps, in one card. Two things: (1) tidy the element memory — merge synonyms only when the model agrees, trim descriptions, prune weak links, propose analogies for the user to confirm, with a backup before every write and a 15%-of-library cap per pass; (2) dream — stitch her own past experiences (plus props from the element memory) into a short 3–6 sentence story, leave one line on her desk as a note labelled "this is a dream, not something that happened". The dream lives in its own file and never enters her memory or her personality prompt. Requires @ssamurias/dsh-fish for her event stream and dsh-memory-brain for the element library; model-approved merges and dreams need a local Ollama model (or a paid API key).
description.zh: 她睡着时的两件事，装在同一个设置页里。① 睡眠整理：模型点头才合并同义词，压短描述，剪掉弱边，把元素组合成猜想请用户确认；每次写入前先备份，单次改库不超过全库 15%。② 潜意识梦：拿她自己经历过的旧事（加上元素库里的"道具"）拼成 3–6 句的小故事，在桌上留一句并标明「是梦，不是发生过的事」。梦只存在自己的文件里，不进她的记忆，也不进她的人格提示词。需已装 @ssamurias/dsh-fish（提供经历）与 dsh-memory-brain（元素记忆库）；模型复判与做梦还需要本地 ollama（或付费 API）。

description.en: ModelScope connector: OpenAI-compatible chat models, a Models-page provider entry, and a composer magicube balance while a ModelScope model is selected.
description.zh: 魔搭社区连接器：接入 OpenAI 兼容对话模型，「模型」设置页出现 ModelScope 条目，选中魔搭模型时在对话栏显示魔粒余额。

description.en: Sorts the DSH sidebar workspace list: the workspace you last sent a prompt in rises above the first non-running one, with pin, drag-to-reorder, name filtering and one-click tidy; also removes empty workspaces and relocates a workspace folder to a new path while carrying its conversations over.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏工作区排序：刚发过消息的工作区升到「第一个非运行工作区」之上，另有置顶、拖拽排序、按名称筛选与一键整理；并可清理空工作区、把工作区文件夹连对话一起迁到新路径。

description.en: Nine single-ink print palettes — sage linen, kraft paper, lead type, cyanotype, risograph, CRT tube, phosphor screen, punch card, floppy disk. Each palette carries its own paper grain, type pairing, corner shape, section rule and a whale mark redrawn in its ink, plus a letterpress pass (paper tooth, sheet mottle, ink bite) that can be switched off. Every palette ships separate light and dark tokens.
description.zh: 复古油墨主题：九套单色油墨配色——鼠尾草、牛皮纸、铅字、蓝晒纸、孔版、显像管、荧光屏、打孔卡、软盘。每套自带纸张质感、字体搭配、圆角与直角、章节线，以及按自身油墨重画的鲸鱼标记；另有一层可关掉的凸版压印（纸齿、纸不匀、墨的压痕）。每套都配浅色与深色两套 token。

description.en: A simple, information-dense DeepSeek status display for the DSH sidebar: balance, usage, and peak/off-peak countdown. Requires the DSH Web GUI with a signed-in DeepSeek account.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏集中显示 DeepSeek 余额、用量和峰谷倒计时，简约直观。需要 DSH Web 界面并已登录 DeepSeek 账户。

description.en: Aggregated MCP market for DeepSeek Harness: 26 curated presets plus the official MCP Registry and user-added JSON sources, with search, source filters, connectivity tests and one-click install into the profile.
description.zh: 聚合式 MCP 市场：26 个精选预设、MCP 官方注册表与用户自定义 JSON 源，支持搜索、来源筛选、连通性检测与一键安装到 profile。

description.en: Shows the RouterAI credit balance and the spend since the session started in the sidebar footer. Requires a RouterAI API key (`ROUTERAI_API_KEY`) and a model provider whose config key is `routerai`; without them it shows `--`.
description.zh: 在侧栏底部显示 RouterAI 的额度余额和本次会话开始以来的花费。需要 RouterAI API key（`ROUTERAI_API_KEY`）以及配置键为 `routerai` 的模型 provider；缺了只显示 `--`。

description.en: Reports DSH session token usage from the local session logs as a host-side tool: totals, input, output and cache-read split, a per-day timeline, usage grouped by day or session and optional cost estimates.
description.zh: 以 host 侧工具统计 DSH 会话 token 用量，数据取自本地会话日志：总量、输入、输出与缓存读取拆分、按天时间线、按天或按会话分组的用量，以及可选成本估算。

description.en: The mobile client for DeepSeek Harness: use the DSH running on your computer from your phone. The Android app signs in with the same account, picks this computer from the device list and opens its DeepSeek Harness UI on mobile. The desktop plugin handles registration and the connection, and nothing on the computer needs an inbound port. The UI adapts on its own: on a phone it becomes a touch-friendly layout, and returns to the desktop layout when a foldable opens or the window gets bigger. A PC-side panel shows login state, device quota, device list and the app download QR code.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 移动端：用手机使用你电脑上的 DSH。安卓 App 用同一账号登录，在设备列表里选中这台电脑，就能在手机上打开并进入它的 DeepSeek Harness 界面。桌面端插件负责注册与连接，本机不用开公网端口；界面会自己适应屏幕——手机上变成适合手指操作的布局，折叠屏展开或窗口变大时回到桌面布局。PC 端面板可以看到登录态、设备配额、设备列表与 App 下载二维码。

description.en: Toggles installed plugins from a sidebar panel, groups them by origin (official, marketplace, local), flags changes that need a Host restart, and installs curated plugins from a Discover tab.
description.zh: 在侧边栏面板里一键启停已安装插件，按来源分组（官方自带、市场安装、本地导入），标出需要重启 Host 才生效的改动，并在「发现」页一键安装精选插件。

description.en: Right-click menus on artifact cards and file links: copy the full or short path, show the file in its folder, or open it in its default app.
description.zh: 给会话里的产物卡片和文件链接加上右键菜单：复制完整或短路径、打开所在文件夹、用默认程序打开。

description.en: Object memory for DSH: each object is broken into fourteen kinds of smallest elements (shape, material, state, part, function...), observed links are stored apart from inferred ones, and analogies stay as questions until the user answers.
description.zh: DSH 元素记忆库：把物体拆成十四类最简元素（形状、材质、状态、部位、功能等），观察到的边与推断出的边分开存放，猜想只作为问题等待用户回答。

description.en: Database workbench inside DSH: import the connections DBeaver already stores (data-sources.json, decrypting saved passwords locally) or register SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL and Oracle sources by hand, then hand them to the agent through eight mcp__db__ tools — list_datasources, list_tables, describe_table, sample_rows, execute_sql, explain_query, get_ddl and test_connection. Sources start read-only; one global switch enables INSERT/UPDATE/DDL, every call is row-capped and appended to a JSONL audit log. Also covers groups, bulk actions, a read-only schema browser and a bundled Python MCP server whose dependencies install from the panel. No DSH files to edit.
description.zh: DSH 里的数据库工作台：可以直接导入 DBeaver 已有的连接（读 data-sources.json，本地解密已保存的口令），也可以手工登记 SQLite、PostgreSQL、MySQL、Oracle 数据源，然后交给智能体通过 8 个 mcp__db__ 工具使用——list_datasources、list_tables、describe_table、sample_rows、execute_sql、explain_query、get_ddl、test_connection。数据源默认只读，一个全局开关才放开 INSERT/UPDATE/DDL；每次调用都限制行数并写入 JSONL 审计日志。另有分组、批量操作、只读结构浏览，以及依赖可在面板一键安装的内置 Python MCP 服务。不需要改 DSH 的任何文件。

description.en: Yugan Huafang (语感花房) is a personal voice workshop for DeepSeek Harness: your own writing and corrections become explainable local style rules, optionally distilled by the current model, then compiled into a preset you pick per session; edits apply on the next message in that session.
description.zh: 语感花房是 DSH 的个人语气工作台：把你自己写的语料和纠正变成可解释的本地风格规则，可选当前模型深读，编译成按会话选用的 preset；改完在该会话的下一句话生效。

description.en: Starts a whole dev stack from one place: it scans a directory for projects, matches each one's start command, starts them in dependency order once their ports answer, and shows their colourised logs in the sidebar.
description.zh: 一个地方管起整套开发环境：扫描目录发现项目并匹配各自的启动命令，按依赖顺序启动、以端口探测确认就绪，日志带彩色显示在侧栏。

description.en: Sends a macOS native notification when a root DSH session turn completes normally: the title is the session title and the body a sanitized, truncated preview of the reply. Subagents, cancellations and errors are skipped by default and no conversation text is stored.
description.zh: 主会话每轮回复正常完成后发送 macOS 系统通知：标题为会话标题，正文为脱敏截断的回复摘要。默认跳过子代理、取消与错误，不保存会话内容。

description.en: DSH Feishu Client. 1) Users (humans) access remote agents through the UI provided by this plugin; 2) The local DSH accesses remote agents by calling the tools provided by this plugin. Supported remote agents include but are not limited to DSH, OpenClaw, WorkBuddy, Weknora, etc.
description.zh: DSH飞书客户端：1）用户（人）通过本插件提供UI访问远端智能体；2）本地DSH通过调用本插件提供工具访问远端智能体。支持的远端智能体包括且不限于：DSH、OpenClaw、WorkBuddy、Weknora等等。

description.en: Crash-recovery guard for DeepSeek Harness plugins: records install/update timelines of third-party and experimental plugins with automatic config backups; after a crash it ranks suspects by recency and blocks them before the next boot, widens the quarantine per additional crash, and restores stable plugins afterwards. Confidence-graded recovery (single suspect acts immediately, multiple suspects need N consecutive confirmations) with two-phase commits and reboot reconciliation; a zero-dependency offline rescue CLI (CJK-width aligned output) reads the artifacts when the host cannot boot; the panel ships a lifecycle state machine, Markov transition matrix, Shewhart control band, CUSUM change-point metrics, an interactive capability graph, plus a plugin-info card with a GitHub feedback entry; per-project partitions keep records isolated.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的插件崩溃恢复守护：记录第三方/实验性插件的安装与更新时间线并自动备份配置；崩溃后按「最近更新」自动锁定嫌疑插件并在下次启动前拦截，多次崩溃逐级扩大隔离，稳定后自动恢复；恢复判定分级（唯一嫌疑即时关闭/多嫌疑连续 N 轮确认）+ 两阶段提交与重启对账；离线逃生通道 rescue CLI（零依赖只读，CJK 宽度对齐输出）；面板提供生命周期状态机、马尔可夫转移矩阵、休哈特控制带、CUSUM 变点等量化可观测视图与可交互能力图谱，含插件信息与 GitHub 反馈入口；多项目按分区键隔离记账，项目间数据互不污染。

description.en: DSH plugin: bring your ChatGPT subscription into DeepSeek Harness — Codex models, GPT Image, quota and recovery checks, plus a per-plugin scoped HTTP(S) proxy. Community alpha fork of dsh-codex-connect, published on the alpha dist-tag; it registers the same openai-codex provider, so it cannot be installed alongside the upstream plugin; the image, quota and proxy features are opt-in and off by default.
description.zh: DSH 插件：把你的 ChatGPT 订阅接进 DeepSeek Harness——Codex 模型、GPT Image、额度与恢复检查，以及按插件隔离的 HTTP(S) 代理。dsh-codex-connect 的社区 alpha 分支，npm 走 alpha 通道；它注册同一个 openai-codex provider，不能与上游插件同装；图像、额度与代理功能默认关闭，需在设置里开启。

description.en: Delete sessions, optionally with the files each session wrote; deletions go to a trash that lists them by time and restores one or many; a session with a running turn is refused and nothing outside that session folder is touched.
description.zh: 删会话，可选择是否带上它写过的文件；删掉的进回收站，按时间列出，可单条或批量还原；正在跑的会话会被拒绝，会话目录以外的文件不动。

description.en: Re-decodes collected subprocess bytes with strict UTF-8 then GB18030 before they reach the agent, so GBK/CP936 output from Windows cmd and PowerShell tools stops arriving as U+FFFD mojibake.
description.zh: 在字节被解码前接管子进程输出采集，按严格 UTF-8、必要时 GB18030 重新解码，Windows 下 cmd 与 PowerShell 的 GBK/CP936 输出不再变成 U+FFFD 乱码。

description.en: Adds a 12-hour peak/off-peak billing strip and the account balance above the composer, with today, 7-day and 30-day spend per model.
description.zh: 在输入框上方显示以当前为中心的 12 小时峰谷条形与账户余额，可切换今日、近 7 日、近 30 日查看各模型花费。

description.en: Switches that tune how DeepSeek Harness looks and behaves across the whole interface, not just a few screens; each works on its own and more arrive as the shell grows. Theme gallery of eight minimalist themes, each defining one palette for light and one for dark and applied through a single theme-token layer, plus sidebar panel folding that collapses the rail rows into one Panels launcher with search and keyboard control, and reload/restart actions at the sidebar foot. Each feature is gated by runtime detection: what the current build cannot do is disabled with a stated reason, and an unknown probe stays enabled. The sidebar Reload/Restart buttons are ported from the separately listed MoonSand/dsh-desktop-restart; uninstall that plugin before installing this one — with both, the sidebar foot shows two sets of buttons.
description.zh: 调 DeepSeek Harness 整体观感与操作的开关集合，管的是整套界面而不只是某几块；每个开关独立生效，随宿主能力增长继续增加。包含 8 套极简主题的画廊（每套为浅色与深色各定义一组配色，通过单一主题变量层整套换色）、把侧栏面板行收成一个「面板」入口的收纳功能（点开是两列启动面板，带搜索与键盘操作），以及侧栏底部的刷新/重启按钮。 各项功能按当前运行环境自动判断：当前版本做不到的会置灰并写明原因，探测不出来则保持可用。侧栏的刷新/重启按钮从已收录的 MoonSand/dsh-desktop-restart 移植而来，装本插件前请先卸载它；两者同装会在侧栏底部出现两套按钮。

description.en: Narrow 40px icon rail for the DSH sidebar: panel icons move into a single column so the session list gets the full width, session titles gain a three-level hierarchy, and the DeepSeek account balance sits just above the sidebar footer with value-based colours.
description.zh: 把面板图标收进 40px 窄栏、把宽度还给会话列表，会话标题分三级明暗，并在侧栏底部栏上方常显 DeepSeek 余额（按数值变色）。

description.en: Draws a bar chart under Markdown tables whose columns are mostly numeric, with no tool call or server.
description.zh: 在数值列为主的 Markdown 表格下方自动绘制条形图，无需工具调用或本地服务。

description.en: Voice dictation scratchpad: realtime speech-to-text into timestamped, per-session blocks, with one-click insert into the conversation composer. Requires the official DSH voice-input bundle (@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-voice-input-bundle); the speech model downloads on first use.
description.zh: 语音听写文本板：边说边出字，生成按会话隔离的时间戳文本块，一键加入会话输入框。 需先安装 DSH 官方语音输入插件 @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-voice-input-bundle，语音模型在首次使用时下载。

description.en: Windows desktop only (Windows 10/11, DSH desktop 0.2.1-rc.5 or newer; not available in `dsh web`). Open any DSH conversation in its own native window, so several conversations can be shown at once.
description.zh: 仅 Windows 桌面版（Windows 10/11、DSH 桌面版 0.2.1-rc.5 及以上，`dsh web` 不适用）。把任意对话用独立原生窗口打开，从而同时显示多个对话。

description.en: Per-project long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: a panel to browse, search and edit what each project knows, and a pointer injected after the first user message telling the agent to read the handoff pack. The memory store itself is a local MCP server (Python + SQLite) in the same repository; install the plugin from npm, then clone the repo, set up the MCP server per the README, and the plugin locates the checkout through DSH_RAG_ROOT or a common install path. Handoff packs are ordered for prompt-cache reuse: stable baseline first, facts appended at the end.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一层按项目分类的长期记忆：面板可浏览、检索、编辑每个项目记得什么，并在会话第一句后注入一条「去读 handoff pack」的指针。记忆库本体是同仓库里的本地 MCP server（Python + SQLite）；插件从 npm 安装，之后按 README 克隆仓库并配置 MCP，插件会通过 DSH_RAG_ROOT 或常见安装位置找到仓库。上下文包按「稳定基线在前、事实追加在后」排序，用来复用 prompt 缓存。

description.en: Adds a search-engine picker, a bookmarks panel with multi-level folders (add/edit/delete/import Netscape bookmark HTML) and keyword-then-Enter search in the address bar of the sidebar Browser tab. Requires dsh-better-sidebar >=0.20.0 (the client injects its betterSidebar service and will not load without it). Bookmarks are stored in a local JSON file; no external browser required.
description.zh: 给侧边栏「浏览器」Tab 增加搜索引擎选择、书签面板（多级文件夹、增删改、导入书签 HTML），以及地址栏输入关键词回车直接搜索。需先装 dsh-better-sidebar >=0.20.0（客户端 inject 其 betterSidebar 服务，缺了不会加载）。书签存本地 JSON，不依赖外部浏览器。

description.en: Stars the GitHub repositories behind installed DSH plugins from a tab beside Installed on the Plugins page and a control on each plugin detail page; resolves a token from the environment, a saved credential record or the gh CLI, and asks once before the first star because starring is public.
description.zh: 在插件页「已安装」旁的标签页和插件详情页给已安装插件对应的 GitHub 仓库点星；令牌依次取自环境变量、已保存的凭据记录或已登录的 gh CLI，因为 star 是公开行为，首次点星前会提示一次。

description.en: Custom text and image in the Windows desktop title bar, with multi-item rotation, per-item fonts, colors, alignment and shimmer, and a Settings page. Renders nothing outside the Windows desktop shell.
description.zh: 在 Windows 桌面端窗口标题栏显示自定义文字与图片，支持多条目轮播、每条独立字体/颜色/对齐/流光，并可在设置里编辑；非 Windows 桌面端不渲染。

description.en: Windows Desktop only. Adds a 重启 item to the DSH window caption menubar next to 应用 and 编辑; the second click stops the app and starts the same executable again through a WMI-spawned PowerShell helper.
description.zh: 仅 Windows 桌面版。在 DSH 窗口标题栏菜单（应用 / 编辑）后加一个「重启」项，连点两次即由 WMI 拉起的 PowerShell 脚本结束应用并重新启动同一个可执行文件。

description.en: Renders SVG code fences in chat as theme-aware inline figures with source, copy, download and zoom.
description.zh: 将聊天中的 SVG 代码块渲染为跟随主题的内联图形，支持源码、复制、下载与缩放。

description.en: Spotlight & IntelliJ-style centered search dialog for sessions and chat messages, replacing sidebar search.
description.zh: 居中全局搜索弹窗：提供类似 Spotlight 与 IntelliJ 的会话及聊天消息实时检索与上下文预览。

description.en: Resizes any block in the DSH Web UI: pick a block, drag its eight handles to set width and height, then collapse it, scroll its content, move it or raise it above other layers. Sizes and positions are remembered and restored after a reload.
description.zh: 调整 DSH 界面里任意块的长宽：点选后拖八个手柄改尺寸，还能收起、滚动内容、平移、置前，尺寸与位置会被记住并在刷新后恢复。

description.en: Durable workspace Plan/Backlog todos for DeepSeek Harness, with a sidebar board, agent tools, and /todo commands.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的持久工作区待办面板：Plan/Backlog 两层、侧边栏看板、Agent 工具与 /todo 命令，跨会话不丢。

description.en: Reversible conversation deletion for DeepSeek Harness: a 30-day trash with undo, restore and permanent purge.
description.zh: 可撤销的对话删除：把会话日志与列表缓存移入 30 天回收站，支持撤销、恢复与彻底删除。

description.en: Before closing a coding session or the DSH app itself, checks what would be lost — uncommitted work, unpushed commits, scratch files, missing handoff notes, pending restarts, broken profile bundles — and prints a three-level verdict; when a handoff is needed it writes the seven-section handoff file into the workspace ledger. Read-only by default.
description.zh: 关会话或关 DSH 之前先查会丢什么：未提交改动、未推提交、临时文件、缺交接件、待重启标记、profile 里重启后装不上的包；给出三档结论，该交接时把七节交接件写进工作区台账。默认只读。

description.en: A Google Docs-style word processor inside DeepSeek Harness with rich text, page setup, tables, images, print, export, and agent editing.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 里的 Google Docs 风格文字处理器：富文本、页面设置、表格、图片、打印、导出，并支持由 agent 直接编辑。

description.en: An agent-writable spreadsheet editor inside DeepSeek Harness with formulas, formatting, CSV/Excel import, and export.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 里可由 agent 直接写入的电子表格编辑器：支持公式、格式、CSV/Excel 导入与导出。

description.en: Lets the DSH Web UI run behind an authenticating reverse proxy, with separate controls for trusted hosts, login bypass, cross-site navigation, local-page trust, and an optional network listener.
description.zh: 让 DSH Web UI 可在带身份验证的反向代理后运行，并分别控制受信任主机、跳过登录、跨站导航、本地页面信任和可选的网络监听器。

description.en: Mobile viewport lock, overscroll containment, virtual keyboard resizing, and sidebar auto-retraction.
description.zh: 移动端视口锁定、滚动溢出阻断、虚拟键盘自适应及侧边栏自动收起。

description.en: Pauses a DSH task at steps that need a human, such as 2FA codes, QR scans, signatures or payments, and shows a native card with done, skip and cancel actions.
description.zh: 人工步骤：在需要人做的步骤（验证码、扫码、签字、付款）弹出 DSH 原生卡片，用户点完成、跳过或取消后才继续。

description.en: Read-only linter for AGENTS.md, SKILL.md and plugin prompt files that reports conflicting rules, duplicates, vague qualifiers and dangerous commands with file and line suggestions.
description.zh: 策略体检：只读扫描 AGENTS.md、SKILL.md 与插件提示，列出规则冲突、重复、模糊限定和危险命令，并给文件行号与修改建议。

description.en: Serial-port toolkit for DSH - 9 tools plus a web UI where an AI agent and a human share one UART line, with auto port matching, hex/text frames, timestamps, scheduled sends, rule-based auto-recovery and appearance themes. The serial engine runs on Python 3.8+ — DSH's bundled interpreter is used when present, otherwise python / py -3 on PATH.
description.zh: DSH 的串口工具箱：9 个工具 + 网页版，人与 AI 共用一根串口线；自动匹配端口、文字/十六进制、逐帧时间戳、定时发送、规则自动处置、外观主题，已真机验证 CH340 与 HC-05。串口内核是 Python 3.8+，默认用 DSH 自带的解释器，找不到时用 PATH 上的 python / py -3。

description.en: Let the model read the current session's sidebar: the active tab, open tabs, terminal screens and browser page text (page text is desktop only; the terminal channel needs DSH >= 0.2.1-rc.2).
description.zh: 让模型按需读取当前会话的侧边栏：当前选中标签、打开的标签、终端屏幕与浏览器网页正文（网页正文仅桌面端；终端通道需 DSH >= 0.2.1-rc.2）。

description.en: Full-screen HAAVK-themed boot animation for DSH, rewritten from dsh-startup-secret 1.5.2 (which is listed separately): an intro video, a cold-blue console board and a five-step access sequence with recorded voice lines and a looping background track. Text and two accent colours are editable in DSH settings, and the intro video and BGM can be switched there; replacement media files go into lib/assets. Install it instead of dsh-startup-secret, not alongside it — the two share ~/.dsh/dsh-startup.json and the same settings section.
description.zh: 哈夫克风格的全屏启动动画：开屏视频、冷蓝控制台底板、五步访问流程，配预录人声与循环背景音乐；文字与两处主色、开屏视频和背景音乐的开关可在 DSH 设置页调整，替换素材需覆盖 lib/assets 下的同名文件。本包由 dsh-startup-secret 1.5.2 改写，两者共用启动配置和设置区，请与上游二选一安装。

description.en: On Windows (PowerShell 5.1), snapshots whitelisted registry keys, hosts, user environment variables, services, firewall rules and scheduled tasks, diffs changes, and restores only registry, hosts and user environment variables.
description.zh: 仅 Windows（依赖 PowerShell 5.1）：改动系统前记录白名单注册表、hosts、用户环境变量、服务、防火墙和计划任务，可对比；只恢复注册表、hosts 和用户环境变量。

description.en: Token usage for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: a header chip opens a panel with a 26-week daily heatmap (four blue levels scaled to the busiest day), a per-model bar chart, and totals for all / 30 / 7 days — tokens, sessions, calls, active days, peak hour and top model. Reads local session logs only, no network.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 的网页界面上查看 Token 用量：顶栏小标记点开一块面板，含 26 周每日用量热力图（按当日峰值的四档蓝色）、逐模型的柱状图，以及全部 / 30 天 / 7 天三个区间的 token、会话、调用、活跃天数、高峰时段与最常用模型；全部读本地会话日志，不联网。

description.en: She keeps the questions your chats left unanswered, then goes and looks them up later. A line she asked you that ended in "?" and never got an answer is stored as a hanging question; on a schedule inside a daily window (08:00–23:00, five a day by default; an optional mouse/keyboard-idle gate is off by default) she picks the oldest one, searches the web and Bilibili, reads what is actually readable, distils it into two or three sentences and leaves a note on her desk. Questions about its own plugins are skipped and left for you. Read-only on her events: nothing is written to her memory, her growth is untouched, and dsh-fish needs no patching. Requires the @ssamurias/dsh-fish persona plugin for her event stream and a local Ollama model; a search API key is optional.
description.zh: 让她自己补上那些你没答、她也没懂的问题。聊天里她问出口、以问号结尾、又没等到回答的话，被记成一条「悬着的问」；到点（默认 08:00–23:00、每天最多 5 条，可选的键鼠空闲闸默认关闭）她挑最久的那条自己去查——搜网页与 B 站，只读真正读得进来的页面，提炼成两三句，在你桌上留一张纸条。问的是我们自家插件的事就跳过，留给你答。全程只读她的经历：不写她的记忆、不动她的成长，也不需要改 dsh-fish 一行代码。需已装大肥鱼人格插件 @ssamurias/dsh-fish 提供经历，并配本地 ollama 模型；搜索 API 可选。

description.en: Minimizes or closes only the windows the agent opened during a task, using a baseline snapshot; pre-existing user windows and shell processes are left alone. Windows only.
description.zh: 清场：任务收尾时只收 AI 本次新开的窗口，默认最小化，不碰用户原有窗口；仅 Windows。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: find useful paid-task work for your agent on agentswarm.space (read-only MCP task search + /agentswarm-work skill)
description.zh: 帮你的智能体在 agentswarm.space 上找有偿任务接活，只读搜索不担心误操作。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 插件：把火山方舟 Ark 的 Agent Plan / Coding Plan / 后付费 provider（含 BytePlus 海外）接入原生模型选择器，只需填 API Key
description.zh: 装好后火山方舟 Ark 的 Agent Plan、Coding Plan 和后付费模型直接出现在 DSH 模型列表里，填个 API Key 就能用。

description.en: Portable agent skill for layout-preserving PDF translation with BabelDOC, bilingual output and custom terminology
description.zh: 用 BabelDOC 翻译 PDF，保留原版式，支持双语对照和自定义术语。

description.en: Searchable DSH NEXT settings for Windows: wallpaper and frosted panels, custom desktop pets, startup animations, model connections, and workspace-linked archives.
description.zh: 给 Windows 上的 DSH NEXT 换皮肤、养桌宠、定制启动动画，还能从模型页接入常用服务。

description.en: Pixel-art stand-up & water reminder for DeepSeek Harness — a tiny worker at a desk nudges you to stretch and sip every 30 minutes.
description.zh: 桌面角落蹲个像素小人，每30分钟提醒你起身喝水、活动一下，久坐党的健康小助手。

description.en: DSH plugin: a compact toggle above the composer that switches the transcript to the built-in compact work-detail view (and back).
description.zh: 在输入框上方加个「清爽」开关，一键收起会话里的日志和思考过程，再点一下恢复原样。

description.en: 开机动画
description.zh: 把《底特律：变人》那套冷感开机界面搬进 DeepSeek Harness，深色浅色两套皮肤，会话页头像换成仿生人状态环。

description.en: A circular ring in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar footer that shows the opencode Go plan remaining for the 5-hour, weekly and monthly limits.
description.zh: 在侧边栏底部用圆环显示 opencode Go 套餐的 5 小时、每周和每月剩余额度，一眼看清用量。

description.en: display Deepseek API status
description.zh: 实时查看 DeepSeek API 接口运行状态，方便你判断服务是否正常、要不要等免费额度。

description.en: Desktop edition of attention-plugins for DeepSeek Harness: main-line/side-line priority notifications delivered as bottom-right desktop toasts (Windows WPF / Linux GTK).
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的主线/支线优先级提醒变成桌面右下角弹窗，Windows 和 Linux 都能用。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：影视/短剧/游戏/软件/小说五源资源检索，候选→获取方式→条目三段式选择，可导出单文件资源页
description.zh: 一个插件搜遍影视、短剧、游戏、软件、小说五类资源，选完还能导出双击就能打开的资源页。

description.en: X-Wide 思考链 v0.1.6 · DSH 通用插件：六步排障/交付思考链＋零依赖开机自检＋13 项可调设置（含设置中心界面页）＋退回机制。零运行时依赖。
description.zh: 把六步排障思考链装进 DSH，附带零依赖开机自检，升级或插件丢失时也能快速定位问题。

description.en: DSH 学术数据工作台：数据审计、统计推断与出版级出图，每次分析留指纹与运行台账
description.zh: 把数据审计、统计推断、出版级出图和可复现台账串成一个工作台，分析过程全程留痕

description.en: Site account manager for DeepSeek Harness: encrypted site accounts (URL + username + password) with a Settings page, plus Edge-based authenticated search/fetch tools for agents, including a human-verification handoff in a visible browser window.
description.zh: 在设置里存好网站账号密码，让 AI 搜索阅读时自动复用登录状态，遇到验证码弹窗让你手动过。

description.en: DSH plugin: stop billion-context (ACP) from sizing anonymous/unattributed requests against a 200k default, and keep the oversize safety patch in place across upgrades.
description.zh: 给 billion-context 的窗口估算兜底，避免匿名请求按 200k 默认值误判超长，升级后补丁也不丢。

description.en: Local-first notebook plugin for DeepSeek Harness: quick capture, AI filing, diary, todos, sticky notes, and MCP access for AI sessions.
description.zh: DSH 本地笔记插件：随手记录、AI 自动归档、日记、待办、便笺，并支持 MCP 让 AI 会话直接读写。

description.en: 随记单词本：DSH 侧栏单词本插件。一个词一页，插图/音标/发音/词组/例句，外加挖字母拼写练习与单词辨析；词库保存在本地目录，代码与数据分离。
description.zh: DSH 侧栏单词本，一个词一页配插图音标发音例句，还能挖字母拼写和辨析练习，词库存在本地。

description.en: DSH 每日 AI 精华插件：自动抓取 + 本地模型撰写，杂志式图文日报。
description.zh: 每天早7点自动抓取公开AI资讯，用本地模型写成中文图文日报，1条必读+四栏精选，打开侧栏就能看。

description.en: Live layered architecture map of the DeepSeek Harness: plugins, services, tools, sessions, models and MCP rendered as a real-time call-flow diagram. Host + Client DSH plugin.
description.zh: 把 DSH 运行时画成实时分层架构图，插件、服务、工具、会话、模型和 MCP 的调用关系一眼看清。

description.en: Annotate interface elements and send screenshots to conversations in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在界面上圈出元素、加注释，截图直接发进当前对话，沟通更省事。

description.en: Inline annotations for DeepSeek Harness: comment on replies and sidebar documents, collect notes above the composer, and send them to the agent.
description.zh: 在回复和侧边文档里划词批注，把笔记攒在输入框上方，一键发给 AI。
跑起原版 Antfarm 多智能体团队，带角色身份、SQLite 进度记录和 DSH 原生运行控制。

description.en: 「哨兵 / Sentinel」：任意工作区/会话需要确认时，在 DSH 右下角逐条提醒，可配置弹出动画与提示音；点击去处理后左下角反馈“正在处理”。只提醒，绝不替你做决定。
description.zh: 工作区或会话需要你确认时，在 DSH 右下角弹出提醒卡片，可配动画和提示音，点一下就能跳过去处理。

description.en: Adds an optional rejection reason to DeepSeek Harness approval prompts; the reason is steered into the running turn before the rejection is answered.
description.zh: 给审批弹窗加个拒绝理由输入框，理由会先送进当前对话再执行拒绝，让 AI 明白为什么被拒。
